# Generated folder — do not edit by hand

Everything in this `app/` folder is generated from the private
square-word-calligraphy repository by `scripts/export.mjs`
(`node scripts/export.mjs <siteRoot>`). The export wipes and recreates this
folder each time, so any hand edit here is lost on the next export. Make
changes in the square-word-calligraphy repository and re-export.

Fonts are subsets of LXGW WenKai and Noto Serif SC, used under the SIL Open
Font License; each licence is in `fonts/*-OFL.txt`.
